### Getting Started
1. **Claim the issue**: Comment below to let us know you're working on it.
2. **Setup**: Follow the [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) guide to set up your local environment.
3. **Branch**: Create a new branch for your fix/feature: `git checkout -b feature/issue-id-short-description`.
4. **Build**: Ensure you can build the project locally before making changes.
